blocks.text: The AirTag Secure Holder with Wire Cable is no different. Durable, secure, and stylish, the AirTag Secure Holder allows you to track your belongings with both confidence and style. Our Secure Holder with Key Ring combines an innovative twist-and-lock design with aesthetically pleasing raised edges to keep your AirTag secure and scratch-free. Recognized by Cosmopolitan for those who love to travel, our AirTag cases are designed with an allen key locking system and braided wire cable that are easily attached to your keychain, car remote, luggage bags, and even a pet collar. Available in black and white, these Air Tag cases can stylishly track your belongings 24/7. Your AirTag will be safely contained in our secure holder while keeping its elegant design and custom engravings on full display.

Belkin Apple AirTag holders are stylish, secure, and flexible. While key rings are perfect for keychains, our durable airtag cases are also available in Wire Loop, Strap, and Carabiner form factors, so you can keep your belongings protected no matter what they are or where you store them. Complete your travel look with your own personal AirTag case, and never again worry about losing what matters most.
Belkin is an established accessories market leader creating high-quality, innovative tech solutions for 40 years.
This product is made with a minimum of 72% post-consumer recycled content, and 100% plastic free packaging.
